construct: label > [input.sr-only + span.box] + span.text — the component forwards className/data-* to the HIDDEN input, not the visible label root (antd Checkbox/Radio)
why: Anything that identifies the root by class or attribute would measure a 0×0 screen-reader-only input and report a clean, empty part. The harness stamps the STAGE child, so the root must still be the label and its visible box must carry paint (P2 exam S2).

canvas.note: the 16×16 filled box is real ink; the sr-only input is a 0-size node the canvas must not draw
